SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id <=> ur.tenant_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 AND ((r.tenant_id IS NULL AND r.role_type = 0) OR (r.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND r.role_type = 1 AND r.role_code != 'superadmin')) WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND (ur.tenant_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_tenant ut INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ut.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_tenant_package tenant_package ON tenant_package.id = t.package_id AND tenant_package.deleted = 0 AND tenant_package.status = 0 WHERE ut.user_id = ur.user_id AND ut.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ut.deleted = 0 AND ut.status = 0 AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ))
AND (ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR (ur.tenant_id IS NULL AND r.role_code = 'superadmin'))
AND ur.tenant_id IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user_tenant ut ON ut.user_id = ur.user_id AND ut.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ut.deleted = 0 AND ut.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ur.tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN sys_tenant_package tenant_package ON tenant_package.id = t.package_id AND tenant_package.deleted = 0 AND tenant_package.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.role_type = 1 AND r.role_code != 'superadmin' AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_tenant_package_permission package_permission ON package_permission.package_id = tenant_package.id AND package_permission.permission_id = p.id AND package_permission.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND p.perms = #{permissionCode} AND p.perms NOT LIKE 'system:platform:%'

SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id IS NULL AND r.role_type = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND ur.tenant_id IS NULL AND r.role_code = 'superadmin' LIMIT 1
